summary: Feature request to upgrade the @opentelemetry/sdk-trace-base dependency in the interceptors-opentelemetry package to support newer versions, enabling projects using OpenTelemetry ^2.6.0 or later to use the Temporal SDK's tracing integration.
userImpact: Users with projects using newer versions of @opentelemetry/sdk-trace-base cannot use the Temporal SDK's interceptors-opentelemetry package due to dependency version conflicts.
rootCause: The interceptors-opentelemetry package has pinned an older version of @opentelemetry/sdk-trace-base, preventing compatibility with newer versions.
proposedFix: Upgrade @opentelemetry/sdk-trace-base in the interceptors-opentelemetry package to support newer versions.
resolutionDetails: This issue was consolidated with #1658 for comprehensive OpenTelemetry SDK trace upgrade.
